programme.title: The Omen
programme.desc: A man faces grave issues after he replaces his wife's stillborn with an orphaned baby.

programme.title: Die Hard 4.0
programme.desc: The FBI gives John McClane an assignment to track down a cyber criminal. So, John joins forces with a young ethical hacker to catch the culprit.

programme.title: Mojin The Dragon Labyrinth
programme.desc: When four adventurers go astray in Gulan County, they chase the truth behind the red spot curse and try to find a way to undo it.

programme.title: Filler
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Catch The Dragon
programme.desc: A palaeontology expert embarks on a quest with a skilled hunter and a mechanic to hunt dragons and uncover the truth about his father's death.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A young motorbike rider must master his new-found powers to confront the emergence of centuries-old enemy forces and settle a 3000-year-old battle.

programme.title: The Boss Baby
programme.desc: A seven-year-old Tim is at loggerheads with Boss Baby, his newborn brother who functions like an adult and works for Baby Corp. However, they team up to foil the plans of Francis, the CEO of Puppy Co.

programme.title: Inside Out 2
programme.desc: Thirteen-year-old Riley tackles high school with her personified emotions guiding her decisions. Soon her newfound feelings cause turmoil and force her to redefine her sense of self.

programme.title: High School Musical 3: Senior Year
programme.desc: Amid preparations for a basketball championship, prom, and graduation, sweethearts Troy Bolton (Zac Efron) and Gabriella Montez (Vanessa Hudgens) vow to savor every moment, knowing that college plans put the future of their relationship into question. An elaborate spring musical is just the thing for these two Wildcats and the rest of their classmates to express their fears and hopes for the future.

programme.title: Disney's The Jungle Book
programme.desc: Mowgli, a young boy raised by wolves in the jungle, faces grave danger when Shere Khan targets him. However, a friendly panther and a bear intervene to help him escape the predator.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Two siblings find an eerie board game after moving into their new house. While playing it, they release a man, who has been trapped in it for 26 years, and dangers from the jungle.

programme.title: Turning Red
programme.desc: Facing a dilemma about her future, a thirteen-year-old girl's life becomes extremely exciting when she turns into a giant red panda.

programme.title: Dead Poets Society
programme.desc: John Keating, a progressive English teacher, tries to encourage his students to break free from the norm, go against the status quo and live life unapologetically.

programme.title: The Lion King
programme.desc: Betrayed and exiled from his kingdom, lion cub Simba must figure out how to grow up and take back his royal destiny from his treacherous uncle on the plains of the African savanna.

programme.title: Home Alone
programme.desc: Eight-year-old Kevin is accidentally left behind when his family leaves for France. At first, he is happy to be in charge, but when thieves try to break into his home, he tries to put up a fight.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: While playing, Lucy and her siblings find a wardrobe that lands them in a mystical place called Narnia. Here they realise that it was fated, and they must now unite with Aslan to defeat an evil queen.

programme.title: Ferdinand
programme.desc: A bull's peaceful existence comes crashing down when the authorities return him to his former captors. With help from a wisecracking goat and three hedgehogs, the giant but gentle bovine must find a way to escape before he meets a famous bullfighter.

programme.title: Gremlins
programme.desc: Billy's father gets him a pet from China with three very specific instructions. However, when Billy does not follow them, it unleashes a horde of monsters.

programme.title: Jurassic City
programme.desc: After the security of a top-secret laboratory is compromised, genetically modified dinosaurs get unleashed. Then, a black-ops unit is tasked with capturing the creatures before they cause more damage.

programme.title: Filler
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A young motorbike rider must master his new-found powers to confront the emergence of centuries-old enemy forces and settle a 3000-year-old battle.

programme.title: Filler
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Samson
programme.desc: Samson, a Nazirite, takes on the role of rescuing Israelites from the oppression. However, he soon finds himself caught up in the evil machinations of a prince, which leads him to seek revenge.

programme.title: G-Force
programme.desc: Armed with the latest high-tech spy equipment, a guinea pig and his highly trained team of rodents are sent on a mission to scupper the plans of a power-hungry billionaire from destroying the world.

programme.title: Breaking Infinity
programme.desc: Time-jumping scientist Liam, guided by a mysterious elder, travels to a future where he sees global destruction he might have caused.

programme.title: Alice in Wonderland
programme.desc: After following a white rabbit to a magical world called Underland, Alice, a 19-year-old girl, teams up with the Mad Hatter and friends to overthrow the evil queen and her dragon.

programme.title: George and the Dragon
programme.desc: After witnessing extreme bloodshed, Knight George decides to forsake war and seek redemption. However, he is forced to get back to his old ways when he sets out to rescue King Edgar's daughter.

programme.title: Lilo & Stitch
programme.desc: A lonely Hawaiian girl adopts a strange creature, unaware that he is a fugitive alien. Subsequently, their growing bond helps heal her broken family as intergalactic captors pursue him.

programme.title: Journey to the West: Conquering the Demons
programme.desc: Tang Sanzang, a Buddhist, decides to free a fishing village of demons it is plagued by. He teams up with Miss Duan, a demon hunter, and begins to fall in love with her.

programme.title: Up
programme.desc: A 78-year-old balloon salesman ties thousands of balloons to his house and flies to South America, but discovers a young stowaway aboard.

programme.title: Upon the Magic Roads
programme.desc: Foal and his loyal friend John embark on a journey across magical roads.

programme.title: The Pacifier
programme.desc: Shane Wolfe, a Navy SEAL, fails to rescue a government scientist, Howard Plummer, from Serbian rebels. Later, he is assigned to protect Plummer's children from his enemies.

programme.title: Cars 3
programme.desc: Lighting McQueen, a legendary racer, is overcome by new generation racers. Later, he sets out to prove that he is the best racer in the world with the help of a technician, Cruz Ramirez.

programme.title: కోట బొమ్మాళి పిఎస్
programme.desc: రాజకీయ నాయకుడు తనకు జరిగిన ప్రమాదాన్ని వాడుకుని ఒక కానిస్టేబుల్, అతడిపై అధికారి ఒక హత్యకు పాల్పడినట్లు ఆరోపణ చేస్తాడు.

programme.title: 143 ఐ మిస్ యు
programme.desc: ఒక జంట లేచిపోతుంది కానీ ఆమెను నక్సలైట్లు పట్టుకున్నప్పుడు వారు విడిపోతారు.

programme.title: అడిక్షన్ కిల్లర్
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత, వ్యసనాలను దూరం చేయడం కోసం ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల ఆయుర్వేద ఔషధాల గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: ఫన్ టైమ్
programme.desc: అత్యుత్తమ టెలివిజన్ కార్యక్రమాలు.

programme.title: సు ఫ్రమ్ సో
programme.desc: అశోకుడి అమాయక ప్రేమ అతనిపై దయ్యం ఉందనే పుకార్లకు దారితీసింది, హాస్య గందరగోళం మరియు ఊహించని మలుపులను సృష్టిస్తుంది.

programme.title: నిర్మలా కాన్వెంట్
programme.desc: పేద రైతు కుమారుడైన శామ్యూల్, ఉన్నత వర్గపు శాంతిని ప్రేమిస్తాడు. కానీ ఆమె తండ్రి ప్రజాదరణ పొందాలని కోరతాడు.

programme.title: డాకు మహారాజ్

programme.desc: புவனா என்ற பணக்கார பெண், ஆட்டோரிக்ஷா ஓட்டும் கணேஷை காதலிக்கிறாள். அவள் ஒரு விபத்தில் சிக்கும்போது விஷயங்கள் மாறுகின்றன.

programme.desc: தொடர் கொலைகாரனை பிடிக்க முயலும் முன்னாள் போலீஸ்காரர் அர்ஜுன், தனிப்பட்ட மற்றும் தொழில்முறை சவால்களை எதிர்கொள்கிறார்.

programme.title: பசங்க
programme.desc: அன்புக்கரசு ஒரு புதிய பள்ளியில் சேருகிறார். வகுப்பில் பிரபலமான ஜீவானந்தம் மற்றும் அன்புக்கரசு இடையே போட்டி நிலவுகிறது.

programme.desc: தேர்தலில் தனது நண்பர் வசந்தனை ஆதரிக்கும் அஸ்வின் வசந்தனுக்கு நக்சலைட்டுகளுடன் தொடர்பு இருப்பதை கண்டு அதிர்ச்சியடைகிறார்.

programme.desc: நாடு முழுவதும் உள்ள பல அரசியல் மற்றும் சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய செய்திகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: கற்றது சமையல்
programme.desc: எண்ணற்ற சுவையான சமையல் குறிப்புகளை வழங்குவதோடு, அவற்றை சமைத்து காண்பித்து மேலும், பயனுள்ள சமையல் குறிப்புகளை பகிர்கிறது.

programme.title: ராமானுஜர்
programme.desc: கற்றறிந்த தத்துவஞானியான ராமானுஜம் நாடு முழுதும் சென்று இந்து மதத்தின் தீவிரப் பக்தர்களுக்கு தனது போதனைகளை கற்பிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: பிரியமானவள்
programme.desc: பாசமுள்ள ஒரு தாய் தன் கணவர் மற்றும் பிள்ளைகளுடன் நிம்மதியான வாழ்க்கை வாழ்கிறாள். இருப்பினும், பொறாமை கொண்ட ஒரு நண்பர் அவளது செல்வத்தை அபகரிக்க இரகசியமாகத் திட்டமிடுகிறார்.

programme.title: கண்ணெதிரே தோன்றினாள்
programme.desc: ரத்னம் தன் குழந்தைக்கு சொத்து கிடைப்பதற்காக பிறந்த குழந்தைகளான சக்தி மற்றும் அனிதாவை மாற்றிவைக்கிறார், அதன் விளைவாக, அனிதா சரியாக வளராததால் ருத்ரா விதியை எதிர்கொள்கிறார்.

programme.title: இருவர்
programme.desc: கோலிவுட்டின் பழம்பெரும் ஆளுமைகளான ரஜினிகாந்த்-கமல்ஹாசனின் மறு ஒன்றிணைவை குறிக்கும் வகையில், அவர்களின் படப்பிடிப்பின் பின்னணியில் உள்ள விவரங்களை பற்றி விவாதிக்கும் இயக்குநர்கள்-தொழில் நுட்ப நிபுணர்கள்.

programme.title: விண்ணைத்தாண்டி வருவாயா
programme.desc: இந்து உதவி இயக்குனர், கார்த்திக் நாற்பது நாள் படப்பிடிப்பிற்கு கோவா சென்றபோது, ஜெஸ்ஸி திருமணம் செய்ய கட்டாயப்படுகிறார்.

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
programme.desc: The filmmaker gives a comprehensive insight into the world's most peculiar stories from history, and diverse narratives from across various fields and cultures.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Rick Harrison and his family own and run a pawn shop in Las Vegas. They purchase, sell and evaluate interesting artefacts with fascinating stories.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Professional buyers go to auctions and explore storage units in search of lucrative as well as interesting items that could fetch them a big profit.

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks
programme.desc: Exploring WWII from Germany's invasion of Poland through the atomic age and examining pivotal battles, wartime leaders like Churchill and Roosevelt and the human cost of total war.

programme.title: Forged in Fire
programme.desc: Top bladesmiths from different walks of life compete to create the best weapons and prove their effectiveness in a series of daunting challenges.
